test_plan: Reserve four new physical configurations, three packing families per configuration, new independent seeds. Freeze configurations and seeds before any new outcome is inspected. Never adapt this cohort.
development_plan: Pilot transition D/d 2.1-3.4 at fixed inclination; use 24 additional attempts only after pilot validity/event review, varying inclination and friction in controlled comparisons. Cross all three packing families with fresh seeds across configurations.
stopping_rule: Stop at 48 attempts including failures; no silent retries, outcome-driven test changes or budget extension. If event/independent-configuration coverage is inadequate, report insufficiency.
numerics: Preserve M3 selected contact parameters and guard initially; any numerical changes require paired validation outside the frozen evaluation cohort.
priority: Independent transition events, resumed temporary interruptions, naturally censored trajectories, crossed packing/seed variation, unseen configurations; no advanced model yet.
